note: Personal staff (docs/career-mode.md, Part 2): hired for one season, paid up front, no refund, and they follow the driver to any team. A role works at Basic (free, no discount) unless a tier was hired this season. Ids are role-tier (crew-pro ... engineer-factory) and are the names of the Shop images at /assets/ui/shop/<id>.webp. cl is the Career Level that unlocks the tier; repairs and upgrades are the share taken off a repair bill and off an upgrade price.
